intro_html:

The magic runs from November 27 (Light Garden at Olive Branch City Park) through January 3 (the last night of the Light Garden), with the Community Tree Lighting (December 3), the Olive Branch Christmas Parade (December 5) and the Holiday Open House at B.J. Chain Public Library (December 17) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.
